parties.respondent: Shri Vile Parle Kelvani Mandal & Ors.

summary: The appeal challenged the Bombay High Court's judgment exempting charitable educational institutions, including those managed by Shri Vile Parle Kelvani Mandal, from payment of electricity duty post-1 September 2016. The State argued that the Maharashtra Electricity Duty Act, 2016, which replaced the 1958 Act, removed the exemption previously granted under Section 3(2)(iiia) of the 1958 Act. The respondents contended that excluding charitable institutions from exemption while including those run by local authorities or statutory universities created arbitrariness and violated Article 14. They also invoked the principle that statutory changes should not be presumed to introduce radical departures from existing law without clear legislative intent. The interpretation of taxing statutes and constitutional principles guided the reasoning.

final_judgment: The appeal was allowed, and the impugned judgment of the Bombay High Court exempting the respondents from electricity duty was set aside.
